public_source.timing_semantics: Tool/runner-reported WebFetch and WebSearch call durations. Applying this distribution to execute is explicitly a network-tool timing sensitivity workload, not a measurement of natural shell execution.

rationale: Predeclared external-tool-latency sensitivity workload, before GPU evaluation. Sample the full observed internal-duration population of these named public tool classes. Do not filter by duration, multiply times, clip tails, slow file operations, or treat timing changes as real project execution.
baseline_requirements: Every compared arm uses the identical prepared timing-map file and original source token corpus.
Natural native timings cannot serve as a performance control for this timing workload.
Keep both this network profile and the shell profile, including negative outcomes, without selecting a profile from GPU wins.
Measure actual cold-state lending, native recovery waits and repeated migration; longer tools alone do not establish an advantage.
Qualify the optional public ThunderAgent acting-token-decay strategy separately before claiming a long-tool-policy comparison.
